evidence.notes: Database.DMLOptions is constructible with documented local option properties.
allowFieldTruncation is readable and writable on the local DMLOptions object.
assignmentRuleHeader is stored for local DML option shape without assignment-rule side effects.
emailHeader is stored for local DML option shape without email delivery side effects.
localeOptions is stored for local DML option shape without locale validation side effects.
optAllOrNone is readable and writable and drives partial success for supported Database.insert DMLOptions overloads.
Database.insert with DMLOptions maps optAllOrNone=false to the existing partial-success SaveResult path.
List Database.insert with DMLOptions maps optAllOrNone=false to local partial-success SaveResult rows.
Public Database.insert single-record DMLOptions plus AccessLevel overload runs through local DML and returns SaveResult shape.
Public Database.insert list DMLOptions plus AccessLevel overload runs through local DML and returns ordered SaveResult rows.
Public Database.update single-record DMLOptions plus AccessLevel overload runs through local DML and returns SaveResult shape.
Public Database.update list DMLOptions plus AccessLevel overload runs through local DML and returns ordered SaveResult rows.

source.content: @isTest private class CoreRuntimeDMLOptionsTest { @isTest static void optionsShapeAndAllOrNone() { Database.DMLOptions opts = new Database.DMLOptions(); System.assertEquals(false, opts.optAllOrNone); opts.optAllOrNone = false; opts.allowFieldTruncation = false; opts.assignmentRuleHeader.useDefaultRule = true; opts.emailHeader.triggerUserEmail = true; System.assertEquals(false, opts.optAllOrNone); System.assertEquals(false, opts.allowFieldTruncation); System.assertEquals(true, opts.assignmentRuleHeader.useDefaultRule); System.assertEquals(true, opts.emailHeader.triggerUserEmail); System.assertNotEquals(null, opts.localeOptions); Account good = new Account(Name = 'Good'); Account bad = new Account(); List<Database.SaveResult> results = Database.insert(new List<Account>{good, bad}, opts); System.assertEquals(2, results.size()); System.assert(results[0].isSuccess()); System.assert(!results[1].isSuccess()); Database.SaveResult one = Database.insert(new Account(Name = 'One'), opts, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assert(one.isSuccess()); List<Database.SaveResult> many = Database.insert(new List<Account>{new Account(Name = 'Two'), new Account(Name = 'Three')}, opts, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assertEquals(2, many.size()); System.assert(many[1].isSuccess()); Database.SaveResult updated = Database.update(new Account(Id = one.getId(), Name = 'One Updated'), opts, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assert(updated.isSuccess()); List<Account> rows = [SELECT Id, Name FROM Account WHERE Name IN ('Two', 'Three') ORDER BY Name]; List<Database.SaveResult> updatedMany = Database.update(new List<Account>{new Account(Id = rows[0].Id, Name = 'Two Updated'), new Account(Id = rows[1].Id, Name = 'Three Updated')}, opts, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assertEquals(2, updatedMany.size()); System.assert(updatedMany[0].isSuccess()); } }
